plans.idea: Faithful centred story stack from the original: logo, large bottle, headline and copy, badge pair, then a full-width CTA, so the reading order goes brand, product, message, action, all on one centre axis.
Headline-first poster: the logo and a big headline block open the canvas, a large centred bottle fills the middle, and the badges sit just above the CTA as one closing action group at the bottom.
Header-bar layout: the logo top-left and the LIMITED RUN / NEW badges top-right share one top line, which frees the centre for an oversized bottle, followed by the headline block and a centred CTA.
